sources.title: DOH Department Circular 2021-0486, 6 October 2021, PDF pp. 1–2 — listed unnecessary items, infection control and phased coverage
sources.checked_evidence: Original two-page signed circular retrieved from HFDB official linked Drive PDF. Page 1: named items and thickness thresholds; COVID-era infection-control context, three-phase transition. Page 2: phase 1 1 January 2022 DOH offices personnel/visitors; phase 2 1 July 2022 healthcare workers/personnel in government hospitals/TRCs/other health facilities; phase 3 1 January 2023 patients/companions/other clients in those settings; facility directives encouraged.
sources.limits: No clinical-supply exception list is asserted: the safety boundary is a BHW role safeguard, not an invented exemption. Targeted official-source search found no later amendment; absence of a search result does not prove none exists. Confirm current local directives.
